description.zh:
HTTPS CA证书的验证指纹。

格式：允许英文字母和数字。

长度：最大128个字符。
description.en:
The fingerprint of the HTTPS CA certificate.

The fingerprint can contain letters and digits.

The fingerprint can be up to 128 characters in length.
The name of the OIDC IdP.

title.zh: 为OIDC身份提供商添加验证指纹

descriptions.zh:
### 使用说明
本文将提供一个示例，为名为`TestOIDCProvider`的OIDC身份提供商添加一个验证指纹`902ef2deeb3c5b13ea4c3d5193629309e231****`。
descriptions.en:
###

This topic provides an example on how to add the fingerprint `902ef2deeb3c5b13ea4c3d5193629309e231****` to the OIDC IdP named `TestOIDCProvider`.
